item.title: Production Desk 1.5.6
item.description:
Production Desk 1.5.6

  • Show the app platform beside Production Desk: MacBook on macOS, Desktop on Windows, iPad on iPad, and iOS on iPhone. The label follows the native device, including resized windows.
  • Show the application version from native build metadata.
  • Keep portable production files, demos, original PDFs, recent interface improvements and the existing desktop update workflow.
